messages:
lina: Heads up — opened a PR to overhaul the Getting Started / Hello app flow. Main goals: streamline auth setup, replace the old curl examples with SDK snippets, and add a tiny Docker-based first deploy. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/987
sam: on it. will check env var names and the auth wording. do we want to show both API key and hosted-token examples?
dario: I think show API key as primary but add a short note about token rotation and using KMS for Private customers. maybe a 2-line example: `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_...`
morgan: +1. also can we make the Dockerfile minimal? some folks get confused by multi-stage stuff in the quickstart. recommend a 1-stage app just to prove the deploy.
lina: good call. current draft includes both a 1-stage Dockerfile and a link to the full multi-stage. snippet in the PR: 
```Dockerfile
FROM node:18-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production
COPY . .
CMD ["node","index.js"]
```
eli: can we add a tiny Node snippet for auth header usage? people copy/paste too often. propose: 
```js
import fetch from 'node-fetch';
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}` },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'Hello' })
});
```
sam: looks good. minor nit: endpoint should be `https://api.redwood.inference/v1` (we changed host last quarter) — I'll update the PR. also add an inline note about scopes for service tokens.
lina: thanks — can you also add a one-line CLI quickstart? something like `redwood login --api-key $REDWOOD_API_KEY` so users can try local commands.
docs-bot: CI check started for PR #987 (docs/lina/getting-started-rewrite) :github:
docs-bot: CI passed — link: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/987/build/12 :white_check_mark:
morgan: small content suggestion: swap the auth section above the Hello World so readers set env before running examples. reduces friction.
dario: also include a short troubleshooting FAQ at the bottom: common 401, CORS for browser examples, and '403 if region mismatch'. keep it 3 bullets.
eli: do we need an example for Dedicated customers (private endpoint)? maybe a single line: `export REDWOOD_API_URL=https://private-host.customer.local` and note TLS/KMS.
lina: added both notes. I've pushed an updated commit with the Docker + Node changes, CLI line, and the FAQ. needs two reviews to merge.
sam: reviewed and left a couple inline suggestions — back to you @lina.
morgan: approved.
dario: approved.
lina: thanks all — merging now. will watch for any README link fallout. merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/abc123 (quickstart rewrite) :tada:
eli: awesome, could we backport the auth wording to the 'Hello World - SDK' doc too? small PR incoming.
lina: yes please — small follow-up is fine. thanks everyone! :)
